name: qgis-rs-py
description: Bun/Turbo facade for the qgis-rs Python distribution. `build` is the whole maturin story: `maturin develop --release` (installs into pixi's default environment and puts the extension next to the mixed-layout Python sources pytest imports) plus `maturin build --release` for the shippable wheel, from one compilation — and it ends by importing `._core`, so a build that produced no native extension fails here instead of as a bare assertion in the test suite. `test` and `coverage` therefore only run pytest, and CI needs no separate maturin or virtualenv step.

scripts.build: pixi run -e default bash -c 'rm -rf dist && maturin develop --release && maturin build --release --out dist && python -c "import qgis_rs._core"'
scripts.test: pixi run -e default env QGIS_REQUIRE_NATIVE=1 python -m pytest tests -v
scripts.coverage: pixi run -e default env QGIS_REQUIRE_NATIVE=1 python -m pytest tests -v --cov=qgis_rs --cov-report=term-missing --cov-report=xml:../../target/coverage/python-qgis-rs.xml
